 arm_rows=[r for r in rows if r['arm']==arm]
 for phase,n,base in (('train',512,830201000),('eval',32,830202000)):

  assert len(selected)==n and {(r['episode'],r['reset_seed']) for r in selected}=={(e,base+e) for e in range(n)}
